name: neutral small-molecule reaction-network growth inspired by ReactionAtlas
primary_metric: root-reachable actual chemical events and distinct-species paths of at least two steps
method: Dimer, force tolerance 0.005 eV/A, 32-geometry batched finite-difference Hessian; 3 geometry variants per atom-mapped action
hybrid: Three symbolic proposal attempts then one geometry proposal when available; geometry also applies to symbol-unsupported nodes
claims: One random seed per system; empirical scheduling only, no neural-model weight update or experimental yield claim
DFT_selection: If a root-connected chain with at least two distinct chemical edges is found, select the earliest such symbolic/hybrid chain from the first listed system with that property; independently verify both constituent TSs. Otherwise report lack of chain evidence.
